summary: Security audit fixes validated. Backend only. 14/14 pytest tests passed covering FIX1 (SyncPay webhook forgery re-verifies via gateway), FIX2 (admin coupon endpoints require admin), FIX3 (per-IP + per-account brute-force 429), plus regressions (legit admin login, /auth/me, IDOR isolation on /consultas, carteira auth, public /planos + /landing, registro short-password 422) and NoSQL injection sanity on /auth/login.
critical_code_review_comments: webhook-syncpay correctly re-consults gateway; forged transaction_id returns status='verification_failed' and DB unchanged (verified via mongosh count of transacoes_checkout / carteira_movimentos with payment_id=FORGED-*).
admin_transacoes.py cupom/validar and cupom/usar now have dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)] — 401 without token confirmed, admin token returns 200.
brute_force_service.py: MAX_TENTATIVAS_IP=20 works — per-IP 429 triggered after mixed-email failures; per-account 429 triggered after 5 same-email failures.
assinaturas.py is 2380 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting into modules (checkout_asaas, checkout_syncpay, webhooks, cupons, admin). Not a security issue.
webhook returns 200 even on verification failures (intentional, prevents infinite retries) — safe as long as no state mutation occurs, which is the case here.
Login is protected by both dimensions and login_attempts collections cleaned after tests as requested.
seed_data_creation: Ran scripts/seed_admin.py to ensure admin password = Admin@2026. Cleaned db.login_attempts and db.login_attempts_ip after brute-force tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_security_audit.py. Run brute-force tests LAST — they leave IP blocks; the suite already orders them last and cleans up. Admin password fallback: run cd /app/backend && /root/.venv/bin/python scripts/seed_admin.py. Login body field is 'senha'. Webhook path /api/assinaturas/webhook-syncpay is bypassed by the rate-limit middleware; SyncPay gateway 404s FORGED-* txids which is the safe path.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration validated fixes; no bugs found.
